intro.headline: Quality Capacity When Your Project Needs It.
intro.paragraph1: Projects do not always need another permanent position. Sometimes they need experienced QA/QC capacity for a defined project phase, production ramp-up, inspection campaign, documentation backlog or client requirement.
intro.paragraph2: Pipeline Quality provides qualified professionals and project-based support according to the actual scope. We can support individual requirements as well as coordinated project quality teams.

intro.point2: technical competence selected according to the actual project requirement
intro.point3: field execution connected to documentation and handover
intro.point4: flexible capacity — one specialist or a coordinated quality team

experience.title: Track Record & Industry Expertise
experience.description: Practical experience from industrial, pipeline and offshore wind project environments.
experience.imageAlt: Industrial project experience in fabrication and inspection
experience.intro: Pipeline Quality is built on extensive hands-on experience in highly regulated industrial and energy environments.
experience.paragraph1: Our professional project background includes QA/QC, inspection, welding, documentation and production support across chemical, petrochemical, energy, pipeline and industrial projects.
experience.paragraph2: Previous project environments and assignments include BASF, Bayernoil, Chemiepark Marl, INEOS, Yamal LNG and other major industrial projects.
experience.label: Experience
experience.referenceText:
Pipeline Quality provided direct QA/QC project support during the fabrication of heavy offshore wind foundations, including XXL monopiles and transition pieces.

Scope included inspection coordination, welding documentation, NCR follow-up, quality reporting, client and third-party inspection interfaces, production meetings, MDR documentation and repair-rate reporting.
experience.scopeText: Coordination with clients and third-party inspection bodies, inspection tracking, production meetings, progress reporting, End-of-Manufacturing Data Record (MDR) compilation, NCR follow-up and repair-rate reporting.
experience.trackText: The project environment included production for international offshore wind developments such as East Anglia 2, Oranje Wind, DolWin and IJmuiden Ver Gamma.
experience.summary1: Recent project experience includes offshore wind foundation manufacturing in the Netherlands.
experience.summary2: Our expertise is built on the professional project experience of our founder and our network of qualified specialists.
experience.offshoreText: Foundation manufacturing, monopiles, transition pieces, welding, NDT, dimensional control, client inspection, production support and quality documentation.
experience.industrialText: Pipelines, oil & gas, chemical / petrochemical, energy, EPC, industrial construction, piping, fabrication, maintenance / shutdown / revamp.

why.companyInfo: Pipeline Quality is operated by Backpack Wander GmbH, registered in Germany and based in Berlin. We collaborate with a network of experienced QA/QC professionals and scale our support according to project needs.

items.question: Can you support audits and client inspections?
items.answer: Yes. Documentation is prepared with audit readiness in mind and supports both internal and external audits, including client and third-party inspection interfaces.

items.question: Can you provide one specialist or a full team?
items.answer: Both. We can provide an individual specialist, several complementary specialists, or a coordinated project quality team selected according to the actual requirement.

items.question: Which standards do you work with?
items.answer: We work in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 45001, ISO 9712, welding standards such as ISO 15614 / ISO 9606, DNV-ST-0126, PED 2014/68/EU and project-specific client requirements.

items.question: Which industries do you support?
items.answer: Offshore wind, pipeline and transmission, oil & gas, chemical and petrochemical, energy, EPC, industrial construction, and maintenance / shutdown / revamp projects.

items.question: Do you provide remote documentation support?
items.answer: No. Pipeline Quality supports both field execution and documentation. Depending on the project, this can include inspection, production support, QA/QC engineering and handover documentation — on site, remotely, or as a combined setup.

items.question: How is BW Digit connected?
items.answer: Pipeline Quality handles quality execution. BW Digit supports industrial data, documentation and digital compliance workflows so field activity can be connected to handover-ready records.

You have the right to access (Art. 15), rectify (Art. 16), or erase (Art. 17) your data, as well as the right to restrict processing (Art. 18) and data portability (Art. 20).
You may withdraw your consent at any time.
